lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: PREVIOUSLY ON QUBLOX: A corporate virus bleached Neo-Amritsar of all saturated joy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sayam threw an entire expense account at a turnstile. It actually worked.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ashwath hacked a rogue Reply-All mothership, but the render farm is still frozen!

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: And my timeline hasn't finished exporting since yesterday morning. Move!
